iphone-push-note.text:
Adapty draws a placement only when a push or a OneLink names it. Push: data.target = the placement id (any id except promotional1–3, introductory1 and the retired placements) → PopupQueue → AdaptyPaywallPresenter → AdaptyAdapter.presentPaywall (Adapty.getFlow → AdaptyUI.flowController). OneLink: only the 16 ids in DeepLinkTargetResolver.knownPlacements. Full answer: paywalls document on VPN-726.
• GetPremium template: APP_START, DID_YOU_LOVE_US, SETTINGS_PAGE, WATCH_ADS_PREMIUM, and GET_PREMIUM, SERVER_FULL, BILLING_PERIOD by push.
• GetPremiumWeeky template: HOME_PAGE_TOP, SERVER_MENU, and GET_PREMIUM_WEEK by push.
• Onboarding template: ONBOARDING_END, and ONBOARDING_START by push.
These three are Adapty's untouched templates (English only, sample texts, links to google.com). Frames: Adapty's builder preview as the operator exported it (small images, iPhone 15 Pro). See Proposals on VPN-726.

iphone-VPN1032-row.text: Proposal — VPN-1032 · push tap: loading box until the paywall, flow or offer shows

iphone-VPN1032-n.text:
Proposal — VPN-1032 · loading box after a push tap · waits for the board's card; nobody builds it before approval.

Today (VPN-1005): after a push tap that opens an Adapty paywall, flow or offer, Home stays as it was, with no sign of loading, and takes taps. The wait is 0.1–1.3 s on a fast network, up to about 5 s on a slow one, up to about 40 s the first time a paywall shows on a device. A failed load shows nothing. A tap during the wait can lose the offer, and Connect does not connect.

The box: the app's own page spinner, NSPageSpinner (Design System card NSPageSpinner; SZDesign/Controls/NSSpinner.swift). Scrim spinnerScrim rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.703) over the whole screen, safe areas included; the white system activity indicator (medium, tinted text #ffffff, box activityIndicatorSize 30 pt) in the centre. No new component, no new token.
Texts: none. No new text (EN and AR). VoiceOver reads the system label of the indicator.
Arabic: nothing mirrors; Home under it is the current Arabic Home.

Where the box shows:
• Paywall and flow pushes: over any Home tab (Home, Settings, Profile), from the push tap until the paywall or flow is on screen.
• Offer pushes: until the offer page P1, P5 or P7 is on screen.
• Cold start: from the end of the splash (it does not show on top of the splash).
• iPhone and iPad (same path). Mac: no frames, the Mac app gets no pushes.

The screen under the box takes no touches: no tab change, no Connect, no server change (NSPageSpinner already takes every tap). A new push tap during the wait replaces the old request.

Time limit: 8 s from the push tap (cold start: from the end of the splash). Reason: it covers the slow-network case (about 5 s) with margin; a longer block keeps the user from the VPN for too long. A load that fails before 8 s ends the wait at once. A paywall that arrives after the limit does not show.

After the time limit or a failed load, the board chooses:
(a) the app's own Get Premium screen (current frames iPhone-GET_PREMIUM-GetPremium-Loaded-EN and -AR, no change), or
(b) nothing: the box goes away and Home stays.
Recommended: (a). The user tapped a push to see an offer; (a) still shows them a way to buy, and the failure is not silent. For offer pushes, (a) shows the normal Get Premium prices, not the offer price.

Frames: the current Home free idle frame (screen canvas, Home — notices · page spinner) is the same picture; these frames are its copy for this proposal.

Proposal — VPN-1276 · the 11 Adapty flow drafts of VPN-1024 get de, es, fr, he, ja and pt (board rule 2026-11-26: every flow screen has every app language). Only texts are added: no change to the layout, the images (except one chevron), the products or en and ar. No new frames. Every text is in the note "Texts — VPN-1276" on the right.

Flows: 1 szf_getpremium · 2 szf_getpremium_week · 3 szf_ramadan · 4 szf_off_copy · 5 szf_p1_z1_a_copy · 6 szf_p1_z1_b_copy · 7 szf_p1_z1_old_copy · 8 szf_p5_s2_copy · 9 szf_p5_s3_copy · 10 szf_p7_k4_copy (copies of the flows on the test_* placements; SecurezoneiOS makes the new copies in step 2) · 11 szf_p1_z1_b_sa_copy (Saudi trial flow, draft). 224 texts, 80 different English texts; each different text has one translation, used the same way in every flow.

Hebrew, right to left: the Arabic layout works for Hebrew as it is. The flows already mirror for Arabic ("Mirror for RTL" on their containers; the Arabic renders passed design review), and Adapty mirrors for every right-to-left language. Condition: the builder gives he the same right-to-left direction as ar (step 2). Hebrew texts are as long as the Arabic or shorter. Prices and numbers stay left to right inside the line, as in Arabic. Images: one file for every language; only the Saudi flow's chevron lc_20 differs: he takes the ar file (chevron-left), de, es, fr, ja and pt take the en file (chevron-right).

Japanese and Hebrew letters: the flows name no font (Adapty export on VPN-1024: "fonts": [], the text styles give only size, weight and line height). So iOS draws them in the system font, SF Pro. SF Pro has the Latin letters of de, es, fr and pt, but no Hebrew or Japanese letters. iOS then falls back by itself: Hebrew to SF Hebrew, Japanese to Hiragino Sans. Both are system fonts on every iPhone and iPad, so no letter shows as a box. The runner has no Apple fonts, so this is not checked on a render here; the device renders of step 2 and the design review (step 3) check it.

Tone: de du, es tú, fr vous, pt Brazilian (você, as the app's pt), he neutral forms (no he / she verb forms), ja polite. iPhone, Settings and App Store keep their names; iOS words: Einstellungen, Ajustes, Réglages, הגדרות, 設定, Ajustes.

Other words than the app's own, and why: Start Subscription — the app's de "Premium testen" and ja "プレミアムを試す" mean "try Premium", but this button shows when there is no free trial: de "Abo starten", ja "サブスクリプションを開始". No ads (es) — "Sin anuncios", not the app's "Sin Publicidades" (capital P; the app says "anuncios" elsewhere). "[offer_billing_period] free" (fr) — "sans frais", because "gratuits" does not agree with "1 semaine". "In [offer_billing_period]:" — de "[…] später:" (the store gives "3 Tage"; "In 3 Tage" is wrong), ja "[…]の無料期間後：" (right with "3日" and "3日間").

Design review of the 30 Adapty renders (step 3, 2026-11-27), on the new copies (ids in flow-config-langs on the task). DESIGN PASS: 2 szf_getpremium_week, 3 szf_ramadan, 4 szf_off_copy, 5 szf_p1_z1_a_copy, 6 szf_p1_z1_b_copy, 7 szf_p1_z1_old_copy, 10 szf_p7_k4_copy. DESIGN FAIL, fixed by shorter words in v2: 1 szf_getpremium (fr badge Best value wider than its card, it touches the side cards); 8 szf_p5_s2_copy and 9 szf_p5_s3_copy (trust line too wide in pt, at the edge in de and fr); 11 szf_p1_z1_b_sa_copy (fr reminder line and fr footer cut; de footer and reminder past the padding; es footer and pt reminder past the padding on a 375 pt iPhone; the fr, pt and ja subtitle breaks the store length "3 jours" / "3 dias" / "3日間" at a line end). Right to left in he: correct in all 11 (close at the right, Restore at the left, icons and badges mirrored, the Saudi video-row chevron points left). Hebrew and Japanese letters: all drawn, no boxes (Chrome fonts in the preview; SF Hebrew and Hiragino Sans on the device). Wraps kept: 3 de plan line, 7 de plan line on 3 lines, 5 and 6 de timeline row 3 ("iPhone-" | "Einstellungen", a correct German break), 11 de es fr pt video row below the button bar at first view (the screen scrolls; VPN-987 changes that row).
